# Scenario: domain + proxy.target.url https upstream → mock TLS for the public
# hostname; nginx proxy_pass with proxy_ssl_server_name and Host from URL host.
# Upstream host is a sibling DNS name on apinfra_proxy_net (resolvable for nginx -t);
# live curl checks public TLS + :80→:443 redirect (upstream may 502 — http-echo is HTTP).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: url https upstream with mock cert'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'skip compose project=e2e-edge \(url-only target\)'
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-edge\.apinfra\.test mode=mock'
stderr 'done duration='
! stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'

docker-assert-running apinfra-proxy
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-origin-web
! exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-edge

exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/e2e-edge.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/e2e-edge.apinfra.test/privkey.pem

# Smoke: public TLS + :80→:443 redirect. Upstream is https→http-echo → 502.
exec curl -sk --resolve e2e-edge.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://e2e-edge.apinfra.test/
stdout '502'
exec curl -s --resolve e2e-edge.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://e2e-edge.apinfra.test/
stdout '301'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-origin
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 19993
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-edge
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-edge.apinfra.test
      target:
        url: https://web.apinfra_e2e-origin
    config:
      cert-issue-type: mock

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-origin/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=ORIGIN_OK"]

-- .env --
